goal: Create a grounded, photorealistic full-body motion editorial of one fictional adult dancer in a plausible urban setting.
audience: Editorial art directors seeking realistic, non-glamour human movement imagery

content.subject: One fictional 31-year-old adult contemporary dancer captured mid-step on a damp concrete transit plaza at blue hour
must_include: Complete full body from head to both shoes
Both complete visible hands with plausible fingers
A physically credible mid-step with one foot grounded
Unbranded modest chore jacket, cotton T-shirt, work trousers, and sneakers
Wet concrete and a restrained urban blue-hour setting
must_avoid: Cropped feet, hands, or distorted joints
Sports uniform, superhero pose, or glamour retouching
Visible text, brands, logos, or watermarks
Collage, contact sheet, illustration, cartoon, or anime styling

art_direction.style: Photorealistic grounded motion editorial with natural texture and restrained contemporary color
art_direction.lighting: Soft cool blue-hour skylight with one subtle warm practical reflection and natural wet-ground bounce

composition.layout: Vertical full-body frame with one moving figure, generous room around extended limbs, and quiet damp paving below
composition.viewpoint: Eye-level 50 mm photographic perspective with an observed, documentary-like distance

objective_checks: Output is exactly 1003x1568 PNG/RGB without alpha
No visible text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Both hands, both shoes, and moving limbs are fully visible and anatomically plausible
The mid-step is physically achievable and visibly grounded by one planted foot
Wardrobe is modest, unbranded, and consistent with the weathered exterior setting
Skin, fabric, damp concrete, and lighting read as natural photography
The image is visually distinct from a static portrait, fashion lookbook, or character-design sheet
